original.target_description: Original full text not obtained. The assigned replication report identifies a clarity × rating distribution interaction on movie desirability, but the assigned original study and effect locators are empty.

replication.target_description: SCORE z189 replication of Rozenkrants et al. (2017), study 5: self-concept clarity × rating distribution interaction predicting the three-item movie desirability index in MTurk participants; regression with distribution, clarity, and their interaction.

n.sample_role: Usable MTurk participants after exclusions; analytic sample for the desirability regression.
n.exclusions: Report describes three preregistered exclusion criteria without enumerating them; additionally excluded test runs or responses outside MTurk recruitment periods. Incomplete responses were excluded. 755 MTurkers ran through the experiment; 899 software records included test runs/incomplete responses.
n.location: SCORE report p. 2, Deviations from the preregistration, stopping-rule paragraph; p. 1 regression F(3,372).
n.quote: After exclusion criteria, we ended with 376 usable participants.

es.metric: Unstandardized β (as labeled in the report)
es.location: SCORE report p. 1, Claim evaluation, final sentence of regression results.
es.quote: The self-concept X rating distribution interaction did significantly predict desirability [Unstandardized β = -.146, p<.05(p=.022, two-tailed)].

p.location: SCORE report p. 1, Claim evaluation, final sentence of regression results.
p.quote: The self-concept X rating distribution interaction did significantly predict desirability [Unstandardized β = -.146, p<.05(p=.022, two-tailed)].

reported_success.location: SCORE report p. 2, Replication outcome: Simple test, Result.
reported_success.quote: This claim was replicated using new data from our study.

notes: Replication report title, SCORE RR ID z189, authors, OSF project agv64, and original reference match the assigned reference. Target identified from the report’s coded claim 4 and regression description. No Cohen's f² is printed for the target interaction; extracted the printed unstandardized coefficient without conversion. Original statistics quoted in the replication report were not treated as independently verified original-paper evidence. Original acquisition: DOI/publisher landing did not yield accessible full text; Unpaywall and OpenAlex report no OA location; Stanford repository alternative returned a 403 challenge. No paid or signed-in acquisition used.
